articles.title: New quantum model slashes hardware needed to break bitcoin keys by 17 times
articles.snippet: Alice & Bob's new model reduces the hardware required for a potential attack, bringing it closer to reality and increasing pressure to adopt quantum-resistant security sooner.

articles.title: House Oversight Chair Comer Probes Delaware Plan for AI-Run Companies
articles.snippet: James Comer warned the proposed "AIC" could shield AI firms from liability, and asked Delaware's governor for documents by November 9.

articles.title: Coinbase Customer Data Hit in Analytics Vendor Breach, Funds ‘Not Impacted’
articles.snippet: The incident at analytics firm Amplitude hit a "small subset" of Coinbase customers, the exchange said, without saying how many.
